[P2] Cover the public return-type correction in an example

Root `AGENTS.md` (Tests, rule 3) and `CONTRIBUTING.md` require an example update for public API changes. This changes an exported overload, but the new type tests import source directly. The existing heterogeneous parallel example immediately awaits the result, so it also passes with the incorrect `Promise` declaration. Update that example to type-check or use the unawaited result as `DurablePromise<...>` through the package exports, retaining its integration test, so the published declaration is covered.
